title: spmeta NowPlaying
description: One now-playing object printed by `spmeta --format json`. When nothing is playing, spmeta prints the JSON literal null instead and exits 3. New optional properties may be added without changing schema_version; consumers must ignore unknown properties.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Incremented on any incompatible change.

state.description: Playback state. stopped is reported only when a source says Stopped but still exposes a loaded item.

type.description: Kind of item. Derived from the Spotify URI or the Web API item type.

artists.description: Artist names in source order. Empty when unknown; never null. On macOS this holds one entry with the app's single artist string.

artist.description: artists joined with ", "; null when artists is empty.

album.description: Album name; for episodes, the show name.

track_number.description: 1-based track number; null when unknown or reported as 0.

disc_number.description: 1-based disc number; null when unknown or reported as 0.

duration_ms.description: Item length in milliseconds; null when unknown or reported as 0.

position_ms.description: Playback position in milliseconds at fetched_at; null when the source does not report it reliably.

uri.description: Spotify URI, for example spotify:track:<id>, spotify:episode:<id>, spotify:ad:<id>, or spotify:local:<...>.

url.description: https://open.spotify.com/{type}/{id} for tracks and episodes; null for ads, local files, and unknown items.

artwork_url.description: HTTPS URL of the cover image; the largest available on the Web source.

isrc.description: International Standard Recording Code. Web source only; null when Spotify omits it.

type.description: Spotify device type, for example Computer, Smartphone, Speaker.

fetched_at.description: UTC time of the read, RFC 3339 with second precision, for example 2026-10-25T17:40:00Z.
